**Code Snippet**


**Describe the bug**

when clicking on trace icon from CI no error message is given saying that you need to deploy to view, instead you just get a blank page and presume it's broken or you did something wrong.

Download html report from CI, extracting the zip and double clicking the index.html to open and click on trace icon.

review_comments: Added tests since—it would be pretty unexpected if the dialog showed up when it wasn't supposed to!
